description: This file generates C# classes for .NET based on protocol definitions in a YAML file, including mapping types and properties, and writing class files with appropriate inheritance and serialization attributes.

methods.name: raise
methods.description: Throws an error for invalid items during type processing.

methods.name: titleCase
methods.description: Converts a string to title case (first letter uppercase).

methods.name: nullableSuffix
methods.description: Returns '?' if the type is nullable in .NET.

methods.name: inlineType
methods.description: Converts protocol type definitions into TypeScript and scheme representations, handling nested types and custom types.

methods.name: properties
methods.description: Generates TypeScript property definitions and scheme mappings from protocol property definitions.

methods.name: objectType
methods.description: Creates a TypeScript object type and scheme from protocol properties.

methods.name: writeCSharpClass
methods.description: Writes a C# class file with the given class name, inheritance, and serialized properties.

methods.name: writeFile
methods.description: Writes content to a specified file path.

methods.name: toTitleCase
methods.description: Converts a string to title case.

methods.name: processCustomType
methods.description: Processes specific custom protocol types into corresponding C# types.
